readout_other: saccade choice task with eye tracking; baseline GABA+ MRS (MEGA-PRESS)
direction_notes: FEF TUS increased selection of contralateral saccades on short-SOA trials; M1 TUS had no significant effect; effect size related to baseline FEF GABA+.
safety_notes: Temperature rise below 2 C and derated intracranial MI below 1.9 (simulation); participants were queried about symptoms at session end but this was used only for debriefing and not analysed.

flags.reason: Duty cycle not stated. A 2 ms pulse at 500 Hz PRF (2 ms period) would be 100 %, which does not fit a ramped pulsed protocol; pulse duration and PRF recorded as written, duty cycle left not_reported.
Paper gives square-wave equivalent Isppa 25 W/cm2 and an effective Isppa of 9.37 W/cm2 (ramped pulses); the 25 W/cm2 is recorded, effective value is in the quote.
39 enrolled; 3 excluded for eye-tracking failure and replaced, 1 further accuracy outlier; 35 analysed. Enrolled recorded.
Post hoc acoustic simulations were run (Fig. 2B) but no in-situ pressure or intensity value is stated in the text; only derated MI < 1.9 and delta T < 2 C.
Sham trials were auditory mask only; paper does not state whether the transducer was in place and silent, so recorded as sound_only plus the active M1 control site.
